The result is a sweet, dense vinegar (1.34 density) with an intense, velvety aroma balanced by a delicate 4.5% acidity. Luxurious yet versatile, it elevates everything from fresh summer salads and roasted medleys to glazes for meats and reductions over cheeses. For a truly indulgent twist, drizzle it over creamy ice cream. Sophisticated, refined, and unforgettable.
